reserveReview.rationale: Slice weights were recomputed on 2026-10-27 from same-block Ethereum reads at block 26282951 (2026-10-27T08:49:11Z): getCollBalance on each of the six USDaf V2 branch holders configured for the live adapter (ysyBOLD 189,488.5558, scrvUSD 42,843.5695, sUSDS 24,982.8034, sfrxUSD 25,698.3089, tBTC 0.5481, wBTC 0.1578). The four ERC-4626 collateral tokens are valued at their on-chain convertToAssets share price with the underlying BOLD, crvUSD, USDS, and frxUSD taken at one dollar, and the two BTC tokens at the Chainlink BTC/USD feed (79,861.76), giving a collateral value near $371,638. The four corrected source keys still match the collToken addresses in the pinned USDaf V2 deployment registry. The general /api/stats endpoint is not independent validation of the V2 composition because its branch balances differ materially from the V2 holders. This reweighting does not establish custody, segregation, or assurance.
